narrative_vs_numbers.summary: ICICI Bank has demonstrated exceptional execution, particularly in its FCNR(B) mobilization where it garnered $18 billion, significantly exceeding the 'momentum' anticipated in Q1 FY27. Management has consistently maintained or expanded NIMs (peaking at 4.36% in Q1 FY27) despite guiding for range-bound performance, while keeping credit costs significantly below the 50bps threshold.
